title: Implement list and record CLI workflows
description:
Create CliApp that provides headless list-sources and record workflows for automation and scripting, integrating AutoRecordController, CaptureIntegrity, and ExportManager from this phase.

Before editing, inspect:
- src/automation/AutoRecordController.hpp for the auto-start/stop API.
- src/recording/CaptureIntegrity.hpp for the provenance/integrity API and CaptureKind enum.
- src/export/ExportManager.hpp for the export API.
- src/app/main.cpp for the existing application entry point and how GUI mode is launched.
- src/pipewire/ for stream discovery and enumeration APIs.

Do not infer APIs, schemas, behavior, or file contents; inspect the referenced files first.

Requirements:
1. CliApp parses command-line arguments using QCommandLineParser with subcommands: list-sources (prints discovered PipeWire streams as JSON to stdout), record (captures from a named source to a file).
2. list-sources: enumerate available application streams, monitor streams, and hardware inputs; print a JSON array with name, id, media_class, and activity fields per source.
3. record: accept --source, --output, --format (wav/flac), --duration, --auto-start, --auto-stop, --pre-roll, --post-roll, --export (comma-separated formats). Print CaptureIntegrity summary including native-vs-converted status to stdout on completion.
4. When --auto-start/--auto-stop are set, wire AutoRecordController; otherwise start/stop on signal or duration.
5. When --export is set, run ExportManager after the master is written and verified.
6. Exit codes: 0 success, 1 argument error, 2 source not found, 3 capture error, 4 export error.
7. Integrate into src/app/main.cpp: detect CLI mode (presence of list-sources or record subcommand) before constructing QGuiApplication; use QCoreApplication for CLI mode.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths.
acceptance_criteria: src/cli/CliApp.hpp declares CliApp with run() method accepting argc/argv and returning an exit code
src/cli/CliApp.cpp implements list-sources subcommand that outputs a JSON array to stdout
src/cli/CliApp.cpp implements record subcommand with --source, --output, --format, --duration, --auto-start, --auto-stop, --pre-roll, --post-roll, and --export options
record subcommand prints CaptureIntegrity summary including CaptureKind (native/quantized/resampled/converted) to stdout on completion
Exit codes 0-4 are used as specified: 0 success, 1 argument error, 2 source not found, 3 capture error, 4 export error
src/app/main.cpp detects CLI subcommands and uses QCoreApplication for CLI mode instead of QGuiApplication
python3 -c "import re; src=open('src/cli/CliApp.cpp').read(); assert 'list-sources' in src; assert 'record' in src; assert 'CaptureIntegrity' in src or 'CaptureKind' in src; print('ok')" passes
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
